content: For example, there may be a foundry that has unique expertise in casting high-chromium white irons, a notoriously difficult material to work with but essential for extreme abrasion applications. Another foundry might specialize in investment casting (lost-wax process) for producing small, highly detailed components with excellent surface finish and dimensional accuracy. Yet another might be a specialist bronze or aluminum foundry. Wear-Resist Alloys , for example, might not use a general-purpose foundry but would partner with or even own a small, highly specialized facility dedicated to its proprietary alloys.
